items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: So means this fellow, Jean-Marie, he wrote songs. So Jean-Marie wrote a song. And I put music to it. ... We published that together.

ctx.x: I'm sorry. I always... Well, he died too. Yes, I heard about him.

Right here in the next block. You happen to be right in the neighborhood where these things took place. In the next block, the Claiborne hardware store bought out two Devil Cottages on Robinson Street to extend their business all the way through from Robinson to Claiborne. Well, those two Devil Cottages, Piku's mother lived in one of them at the time. And a friend of mine, Jean-Marie, his mother lived there. And on account of coming there with him, I found out that Piku's mother was living there in the…
Well you imagine that Pinker's brother is full of jokes you say?
